chunks: I advise you (both), and all my children and my family, and whoever my letter reaches, to fear Allah, to keep your affairs in order, and to maintain good relations among yourselves.
For I have heard your Grandfather (peace be upon him and his family) saying, 'Improvement of mutual differences is better than general prayers and fastings.'

key_terms.ذَاتِ الْبَيْنِ: Mutual relations or kinship ties (specifically referring to reconciliation between parties)

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of reconciling family differences in Shia Islamic teachings according to Imam al-Hasan's will?
ai.summary: This passage from Imam al-Hasan’s (AS) final testament to his brother Imam al-Husayn (AS) underscores the critical importance of internal unity (صلح ذات البين) as a prerequisite for preserving the Ahl al-Bayt's legacy. By citing the Prophet’s tradition, Sharif al-Radi highlights that mending interpersonal bonds holds superior merit to general acts of worship, a principle that guided the family's strategy during the turbulent post-Prophetic era. This emphasis on social cohesion reflects the Shia scholarly view that maintaining the integrity of the community is as vital as individual piety.
